thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — we’re soft-launching a new GPU pool today: G730e (internal codename 'Aurora-G7'). Available in Manila (MNL) and Toronto (YYZ) as preview capacity. This is a latency-optimized, low-precision variant tuned for high-throughput chat and embed workloads. :sparkles;

elaine: Ops note — rollout is staged: Manila first (2:00 UTC), Toronto follows (6:00 UTC). We’ll keep burst windows open for the first 48h. Monitoring dashboards will show a new pool tag `g730e-preview`. :mag;

sanjay: Numbers? how many cards per region and expected AMP/memory differences vs A100x?

maria: Manila: 40 cards across 5 racks. Toronto: 24 cards across 3 racks. G730e uses ~40% less memory bandwidth for float16 paths; expect ~1.6x throughput on small-chat batch sizes vs our current g5-like baseline. Pricing is in the preview doc (internal link) — preview pools are metered at ~15% lower than standard dedicated rate to encourage testing.

tara: Will this affect existing Dedicated reserved customers or queue priority / fairshare?

maria: Reserved capacity is unaffected. These are new pools under the "preview" capacity tier. Important callout: starting next week we’re enforcing a new reservation tag policy — all new reservations must include `workload_class` (values: dev, staging, prod). This helps routing and observability. Existing reservations are grandfathered for 60 days.

elaine: Migration helpers live at `infra/redwoodctl/scripts/attach_workload_tag.sh` — run like: 
```
./attach_workload_tag.sh --reservation R-12345 --tag prod
```
We’ll run a one-time audit on Friday; missing tags will trigger an email warning then a 14-day remedial window.

ops-bot: Scheduled: audit-reservation-tags will run 2026-04-02T15:00:00Z across MNL/YYZ preview pools. Alerts will go to #eng-oncall and #product.

sanjay: Thanks — any guidance for model-quant profiles? Should we stick to Q4-int8 for now?

maria: For early testing use q4_0 and q8_0 profiles — G730e shows best perf/quality at q4_0 for chat; we’ll publish tuned defaults to the model catalog tomorrow. If you need a backfill to q8_0 we’ve got an automated fallback in the runtime.

tara: Can we get a shortblurb for customers using Dedicated UI so CS can proactively reach out?

maria: Yep — drafting a 1-paragraph note for CS + a KB. Will post in #customer-success once done.

elaine: Ops checklist for oncall: watch token-level latency, p90 gen time, and memory errors. I’ll pin the dashboard link in #eng-sre 10min before Manila stage.

maria: Thanks all — please test workloads against `model=g730e/*` and leave feedback in the doc. If you hit anything weird ping @maria directly. :thumbsup:
